! Game text
| Deploy on table (only at start of game) with three different [Vader] Effects from Reserve Deck face down under here. Once per turn, may deploy a [Vader] Effect from here (never from elsewhere). Limit one [Vader] Effect on table and, when lost, stack it under here. You may cancel your [Vader] Effect at any time. '''Twisted And Evil''': Dark Jedi Presence, Jedi Presence, Revenge Of The Sith and Sith Tests are canceled. When using The Empire’s Back to ▼ Vader, it is a Used Interrupt. If you just drew a [Vader] card for destiny, may take it into hand.  ||  Deploy on table ({{Errata hl|1=deploys}} only at start of game) with three different [Vader] Effects from {{Errata hl|1=your}} Reserve Deck face down under here. Once per turn, may deploy a [Vader] Effect from here (never from elsewhere). Limit one [Vader] Effect on table and, when lost, stack it under here. You may cancel your [Vader] Effect at any time. '''Twisted And Evil''': Dark Jedi Presence, Jedi Presence, Revenge Of The Sith and Sith Tests are canceled. When using The Empire’s Back to {{Errata hl|1=deploy}} Vader {{Errata hl|1=from Reserve Deck}}, it is a Used Interrupt. If you just drew a [Vader] card for destiny, may take it into hand.  ||  Deploy on table (only at start of game) with three different [Vader] Effects from Reserve Deck face down under here. Once per turn, may deploy a [Vader] Effect from here (never from elsewhere). Limit one [Vader] Effect on table and, when lost, stack it under here. You may cancel your [Vader] Effect at any time. == Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Virtual Legacy [[Rise Of The Dark Lord]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published text state; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous column. Same-words image changes are not columns: [[Rise Of The Dark Lord (Errata 3)]] shares the [[Rise Of The Dark Lord (Errata 2)]] column. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
